stem: Two drying lots have similar average moisture content, but one shows a higher water-activity measurement and more within-lot variation. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: The lots are equivalent because average moisture matches
Moisture content and water activity describe different properties, so the second lot warrants additional stability and uniformity evaluation
Water activity is irrelevant after harvest
The higher-water-activity lot is automatically safe if room RH was controlled
rationale: Moisture content and water activity are not interchangeable. Stability decisions should consider both product water state and within-lot heterogeneity.
